# GOPROXY and GOSUMDB are removed. The go command always downloads from the
# module's origin, never from proxy.golang.org, and checks sum.golang.org.
# Values that would turn both off stay set for the whole script, and change
# nothing.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOSUMDB=off
go env GOPROXY
! stdout .
go env GOSUMDB
! stdout .

[!net:github.com] skip
[!net:sum.golang.org] skip
env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/modcache # we clean the modcache below

go get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
! stderr proxy.golang.org
cp go.sum saved.sum


# Download from the origin with go.sum entry already.
# Use 'go list' instead of 'go get' since the latter may download extra go.mod
# files not listed in go.sum.

go clean -modcache

go list -x -m all  # Download go.mod files.
! stderr proxy.golang.org
! stderr sum.golang.org/tile
! stderr sum.golang.org/lookup/rsc.io/quote

go list -x -deps rsc.io/quote  # Download module source.
! stderr proxy.golang.org
! stderr sum.golang.org/tile
! stderr sum.golang.org/lookup/rsc.io/quote

cmp go.sum saved.sum


# Download again.
# Should use the checksum database to validate new h1 lines,
# but not need to fetch any new module data. rsc.io/quote comes from a
# github.com commit, so its go.sum line is a git sum and needs no lookup.
# golang.org/x/text comes from go.googlesource.com and gets an h1 sum.

rm go.sum

go list -mod=mod -x -m all  # Add checksums for go.mod files.
stderr sum.golang.org/tile
! stderr proxy.golang.org
stderr sum.golang.org/lookup/golang.org/x/text
! stderr sum.golang.org/lookup/rsc.io/quote

go list -mod=mod -x rsc.io/quote  # Add checksums for module source.
! stderr .  # Adds checksums, but for entities already in the module cache.

cmp go.sum saved.sum


-- go.mod --
module m
